deep_dive.title: Phases in a class of associative memories via hidden neurons
deep_dive.abstract: Associative memory in the Hopfield network is attractor dynamics in a disordered many-body system, and higher-order and exponential extensions turn its retrieval update into softmax attention. The polynomial and exponential regimes have been analyzed by different methods, with no common architecture in which to ask what fixes the storage scale. In this paper we study the bipartite architecture of Krotov and Hopfield, which we call the class $H$, whose model is fixed by a Lagrangian for each layer, taking the hidden neurons as the order parameter of retrieval. At polynomial load the replica method yields the replica-symmetric phase diagrams and closed-form capacities, and the crosstalk moment is common to Ising and spherical visible neurons, so their differences come from the visible entropy. With a softmax hidden layer the load is exponential, and a copy representation maps the thermodynamics onto random-energy-model counting, with paramagnetic, condensed, and frozen phases. Heating destabilizes retrieval by quantized reassignments of attention, and typical Gaussian patterns remain metastable at every load. The regimes differ in their crosstalk statistics, central-limit at polynomial load and large-deviation at exponential load, and the class $H$ splits retrieval into two roles, the visible Lagrangian fixing stability and the hidden one the storage scale, two axes that may also guide the design of new Lagrangians.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Hopfield associative memory is attractor dynamics, and its higher-order and exponential extensions turn retrieval into softmax attention. This work studies the Krotov-Hopfield bipartite class H, using the replica method to derive phase diagrams and closed-form capacities that unify storage scale across regimes.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: Hopfield网络的联想记忆本质是无序多体系统的吸引子动力学，其高阶与指数扩展可将检索更新变为softmax注意力，但多项式与指数情形此前用不同方法分析，缺乏统一架构探讨存储尺度。本文研究Krotov-Hopfield二分架构类H，以隐神经元作为检索序参量，用副本方法在多项式负载下推导副本对称相图与闭式容量。结果显示串扰矩在Ising与球面可见神经元间通用，为联想记忆容量提供了统一理论视角，并与注意力机制建立联系。
